info.title: GlobalPay API
info.description:
Pay Thai PromptPay QRs with USDC on Base. Testnet demo: partners are simulated.

Money is sent as integer strings in minor units: THB satang ("10000" = 100.00 THB) and USDC base units ("1000000" = 1 USDC). Rates are THB per USDC × 1e8.

signature.description: The sender's wallet signature over the TransferWithAuthorization

token.description: USDC: its 0x address (EVM rail) or contract account ID (NEAR rail)

publicKey.description: P-256 public key, SPKI DER, base64

KycSession.description: For the provider's mobile SDK. Null if the user is already approved.

NearPayment.description: NEAR rail: sign this as a NEP-366 delegate action (one FunctionCall), then send the borsh SignedDelegate, base64, as `signedDelegate` to POST /payments. The relayer pays the gas. Absent on the EVM rail.

signerId.description: The payer's implicit account (the delegate action's sender_id)

nonce.description: The delegate action's nonce: the access key's nonce + 1

maxBlockHeight.description: The delegate action is void after this block height

amount.description: USDC base units: the quote tokenAmount

msg.description: JSON {"quote": <quote JSON>, "signature": <base64 ed25519>} that the settlement contract checks

address.description: Wallet that will sign in: a 0x address (EVM rail) or a NEAR implicit account (NEAR rail)

nonce.description: EVM rail: the SIWE nonce. NEAR rail: the NEP-413 nonce, 32 bytes as hex

message.description: EVM rail: EIP-4361 message to sign with personal_sign, unchanged. NEAR rail: the NEP-413 `message` to sign, unchanged, with this nonce and recipient = the sign-in domain

payer.description: 0x address (EVM rail) or NEAR implicit account (NEAR rail)

token.description: USDC: its 0x address (EVM rail) or contract account ID (NEAR rail)

tokenAmount.description: USDC base units (6 decimals), spread included

OnChainQuote.description: The on-chain Quote struct, as signed. Send it back unchanged with the payment.

status.description: CREATED: waiting for you to pay. PENDING: paid, USDC on its way. COMPLETED: USDC arrived in your wallet (checked on-chain). FAILED: the purchase failed. EXPIRED: not paid in time.

tokenAmount.description: USDC base units: received, or promised by the partner

verified.description: The name comes from identity verification

status.description: CREATED: waiting for a tap or a scan. SENDER_IDENTIFIED: waiting for the sender to approve. APPROVING: the sender approved and the transfer is being sent; it can no longer be cancelled. SUBMITTED: transfer sent. COMPLETED and FAILED: the transfer was mined (or reverted). EXPIRED, DECLINED, CANCELLED: nothing moved.

challenge.description: Receiver only, while CREATED: send it to the other phone over NFC, or show it in the QR

status.description: SETTLED, REFUNDED and FAILED are final. Poll until one of them.

token.description: USDC: its 0x address (EVM rail) or contract account ID (NEAR rail)

tokenAmount.description: USDC base units the user pays

PaymentPayout.description: Paying the merchant in THB. Absent until the payment is paid on-chain.

status.description: PENDING: being paid. SUCCEEDED: the merchant was paid (see reference). FAILED: not paid; the user is refunded. UNKNOWN: unclear, being checked; never settled or refunded until it is clear. REVERSED: paid, then undone.

reference.description: Bank or partner reference, once paid

validAfter.description: EVM rail (required there): from authorizationToSign.message, unchanged

validBefore.description: EVM rail (required there): from authorizationToSign.message, unchanged

signature.description: EVM rail (required there): the payer wallet's signature over authorizationToSign

signedDelegate.description: NEAR rail (required there): base64 of the borsh SignedDelegate (NEP-366) for nearPayment

feeTokenAmount.description: The spread, in USDC base units

payer.description: Wallet that will pay; must be the signed-in user's wallet (a NEAR implicit account on the NEAR rail)

fiatAmountMinor.description: THB satang. Required when the QR has no amount; must match it when it has one.

signature.description: GlobalPay's signature over the quote: EIP-712, 0x hex (EVM rail), or ed25519 over the quote JSON, base64 (NEAR rail)

ReceiveAuthorizationTypedData.description: EVM rail: EIP-712 typed data for the wallet (eth_signTypedData_v4): USDC ReceiveWithAuthorization. Absent on the NEAR rail.

signature.description: EVM rail: personal_sign signature over `message` (0x hex). NEAR rail: the NEP-413 ed25519 signature (base64, 64 bytes)

publicKey.description: NEAR rail (required there): the key that signed, "ed25519:" + base58

hash.description: 0x hash (EVM rail) or base58 hash (NEAR rail)

walletAddress.description: 0x address (EVM rail) or NEAR implicit account (NEAR rail)

post.summary: Start sign-in: get a one-time nonce and the message to sign
Finish sign-in: verify the signed message and get an access token
Start identity verification (mock: approved on the next status check)

get.summary: Verification status, tier and spending limits

post.summary: Quote a PromptPay QR payment in USDC
post.description: Parses the QR, checks KYC limits, prices it at the live rate plus the spread, and signs it. The quote expires after QUOTE_TTL_SECONDS (60 s by default). EVM rail: sign `authorizationToSign` with the payer wallet. NEAR rail: sign `nearPayment` as a delegate action. Then submit it to POST /payments.

post.summary: Pay a quote with the signed USDC authorisation
post.description: Checks the signature and limits, then relays the payment and returns at once with status SUBMITTED. EVM rail: send validAfter, validBefore and signature (relays pay()). NEAR rail: send signedDelegate (relays the meta transaction). Poll GET /payments/{id} until SETTLED, REFUNDED or FAILED. Submitting the same quote again returns the same payment.

get.summary: USDC balance of the signed-in user's wallet
USDC that arrived in your wallet from outside, newest first (last 50)
get.description: Found on-chain by the deposit watcher, a few blocks after they land. Refunds show on their payment instead.

post.summary: Add money: start buying USDC with baht
post.description: Returns the partner's checkout page to open in the browser (a Custom Tab). The USDC goes to the signed-in user's wallet. Poll GET /onramp/orders/{id} until COMPLETED, FAILED or EXPIRED. checkoutUrl may be relative to the API (the local simulator).

get.summary: An Add-money order, checked with the partner if due

put.summary: Set the name others see when paying you

post.summary: Register this phone's hardware key (and push token) for tap to pay
post.description: Registering the same key again refreshes its push token. The returned ID is what the phone announces when tapped.

delete.summary: Stop this phone being used to pay

post.summary: Ask someone to pay you (tap to pay, or they scan your QR)
post.description: Expires after 2 minutes. Show the QR (request ID and challenge) or hold the other phone near yours.

get.summary: Requests you received or paid, newest first (last 50)

get.description: Poll this while the tap screen is open, in case a push notification is slow or push is off.

get.summary: A request you received or are paying

post.summary: Receiver: forward the other phone's NFC answer
post.description: The device ID the other phone announced, and its P-256 signature (DER) over "GLOBALPAY-TAP-1" followed by the challenge.

post.summary: Sender: claim a request from the receiver's QR

get.summary: Sender: the USDC transfer to sign (EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization)

post.summary: Sender: approve with the signed transfer; the backend relays it
